drawings.description: en bas à gauche, un croquis : un anneau hachuré $\widetilde{\partial P}$ bordé par le cercle $\partial P$
drawings.kind: hatched annulus bordered by a circle
drawings.notes: An annulus between two circles, hatched by short radial strokes (their number schematised), labelled with the tilde-boundary of P inside at the top; the outer circle is labelled del P at the right.

drawings.description: à gauche et à droite, deux croquis de flèches entre $\partial P$, $\widetilde{\partial P}$, $\partial P'$, $\widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P$, $\widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P'$ et $P - P' = \widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P'$, avec la mention « équivalences d'\ill{} »
drawings.kind: two arrow sketches between boundaries of P and P'
drawings.notes: Left: del P' and del P above and below, joined by arrows to tilde-del P - del P and tilde-del P - del P' (each followed by an equivalence sign) and to tilde-del P, with "= P - P'" beside; right: del P -> tilde-del P <- del P', with tilde-del P - del P below and P - P' = tilde-del P - del P' above, and "équivalences d'..." under it (the last word illegible, as in the transcription). Arrow directions as on the page; the left sketch is crossed by the large frame line of the page, not drawn.

drawings.description: croquis dans la marge gauche ; sous $P \cap Q = R$, en colonne : $\partial P = T$, le $R$ étant surchargé
drawings.kind: margin diagram of inclusions W, P, Q, P cap Q = R = del P
drawings.notes: Q° over Q, W -> Q (hooked), P inside W (vertical inclusion), P° -> P and P <- P cap Q = R (hooks), and under P cap Q = R, in a column, del P = T; the R is overwritten. The hooks are drawn as small curls at the line ends.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : un disque marqué « $P$ », entouré d'un anneau hachuré ; à droite de l'anneau, « $\widetilde{P}$ ».
drawings.notes: Two nested closed curves drawn freehand, the ring between them hatched with short oblique strokes; P inside the inner curve, P-tilde to the right of the outer one. The outer curve is an oval leaning to the right, wider at the bottom left; the inner one is open at the upper left, where a separate stroke continues it and a heavy stroke doubles the outer curve. Outside the ring on the right, a curved stroke runs from the top down and round the lower right of the outer curve, with a short tail rising from it towards P-tilde; drawn as on the page. The hatching: short strokes in the upper band, long oblique strokes in the left and lower bands, a few in the right band. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the earlier redraw drew two circles with radial hatching, which did not match the leaning ovals of the page; the curves, the hatching, the right-hand stroke and its tail are now traced through points measured on the page. The transcription's note matches. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la page, premier diagramme en perspective : les lettres $S$, $W$, $T$ en haut, $P$, $Q$, $M$, $R$, $N$, $t$ au milieu, $T$ et $S$ repassés, $(s,t)$, $\emptyset$ et $t$ en bas, reliées par des flèches montantes dont plusieurs épaisses ; des ovales au crayon entourent des groupes de lettres ; deux plages hachurées, à gauche et à droite en bas.
drawings.kind: arrow diagram in perspective (lattice of inclusions), with hatched regions
drawings.notes: The letters are placed as on the page and the arrows drawn between the places where they start and end on the page: M to the upper left, P to S (top), a faint line from s to S, P to W and M to P (hooked), R to P (heavy), Q to the upper left (heavy), Q to T, t to T, R to Q, N to Q, N to t, T (heavy letter) to M, T to R, S (heavy letter) to R, S to N, (s,t) to T and to S, the empty set to (s,t), S down to the lower t (heavy), and a dashed stroke from that t up to a small T on the right. Under R, a small vertical equality sign and T x S. Four pencil ovals surround P and R, M and T, R and Q, S and N; two scribbled hatchings at the lower left (with two small s) and lower right. Partial: the hooks, dots and small crosses on several arrows (M to P, P to W, T to R, S to N carry a hook or a cross) are not drawn; arrow heads retraced on the page are drawn once; the ovals and hatchings are placed by eye; which letter each arrow reaches is read from its direction, and several are doubtful (Q's upper-left arrow ends in the blank between W and T; M's ends near the small s). Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: letters and arrows match the page within about a unit; the oval round R and Q was too short and too flat in its tilt and is corrected (35 degrees); the hatching at the lower right was drawn sloping the wrong way and about 5 units low, and is now strokes rising to the right over the place of the scribble; both hatchings remain schematic (the page has zigzag scribbles). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ rasterised and laid over the 236 ppi colour scan (rendered at 350 dpi), with an ink/pencil separation of the crop to follow the faint strokes. Redrawn element by element on the scan: every arrow between the points where its ink starts and ends (several were 1 to 2 units off), with what it carries on the page: the hooked tails (P to W, M to P, R to Q, T to R, (s,t) to S, S to N: a small c; N to Q, S to R, T to M, (s,t) to T, the empty set to (s,t): a U or J; Q's upper-left arrow and R to P: a short upturn), the heavy dots (on P to W, M to P, Q's upper-left arrow, R to Q, T to R, S to R), the small ring on R to P, the cross on T to M and the asterisk on S to N; the arrow from S down to the lower t ends in a right-angle head; the dashed stroke starts from a small c and ends at the foot of the small T. The four pencil ovals are now the open curves they are on the page, through points read on them: round P and R (open where P to W crosses it), round R and Q (its lower edge broken), round S and N (open above N), and the one round M and T in three pieces (open at the M to P hook and below T), with two short pencil strokes between it and the first oval. Letters moved onto their ink (W, M, T x S and the vertical equality sign were 1 unit off). Every element lies on the ink to within about 1 unit. Still differs, hence partial: the two hatchings are scribbles; the one at the lower left is drawn as a zigzag through the turning points of its loops (its strokes are curved and doubled on the page), the one at the lower right as its separate straight strokes with the long curve under them; the head of the arrow from (s,t) to S is a blot on the page, drawn as a small head.

drawings.description: au-dessous, second diagramme en perspective, sur les lettres correspondantes : $V'$ et $V'_s$ en haut, $X'_{\eta}$, $V'_s$, $t$, $e$ au milieu, $X'_{\eta}$, $V'_s \times \eta$, $V'_s$, $\eta$, $(s,t)$, $t$ en bas, reliées par des flèches montantes épaisses ; un cadre en traits doubles et un cadre au crayon ; à droite, un quadrilatère hachuré.
drawings.kind: arrow diagram in perspective (lattice of inclusions), with frames and a hatched region
drawings.notes: The letters are placed as on the page and the arrows drawn between the places where they start and end. A frame of heavy and double strokes runs round X'_eta and V'_s x eta; a thin pencil quadrilateral lies under the lower X'_eta and V'_s; at the right a small quadrilateral is hatched, with an arrow from its upper right corner. Left out: the node at the top left, blotted out in ink (two arrows end on it; they are drawn); the letter at the far right, struck (it reads V'_s or X'_s) and the small round letter beside the hatched quadrilateral (e or a zero); the small s at the left is drawn although it looks struck. Partial: hooks and tildes on several arrows are not drawn (the arrows V'_s to V'_s at the top right and e to t carry a tilde; the second is drawn as a plain stroke); which letter each arrow joins is read from its direction; frames and hatching are placed by eye. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: letters, arrows, frames and the two quadrilaterals match the page within about a unit; nothing corrected. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ rasterised and laid over the 236 ppi colour scan (rendered at 350 dpi), with an ink/pencil separation of the crop. Redrawn element by element on the scan (letters, arrows and frames were up to 3 units off): the eighteen arrows between the points where their ink starts and ends, with what they carry: the hooked tail of X'_eta to V' (a U), of V'_s to V' (a U) and of e to V'_s (a short upturn), the tilde over the tail of the arrow up to the upper right V'_s, and the arrow from e to t with its hooked head and the tilde stroke above it; the frame: the heavy upper left side with a thin stroke inside it, the upper right side heavy with two thin strokes beside it (the double stroke), the heavy lower sides meeting under V'_s x eta; the pencil quadrilateral (its place was right) with the two short pencil strokes across its lower left side; the hatched quadrilateral with its two heavy sides, its thin upper left side and six strokes across it, the chevron at its upper right corner and the closed loop beside it (the small round letter, e or a zero, unread, drawn as the loop it is); the struck letter at the far right (V'_s or X'_s), its prime and subscript, and the stroke through it, in the struck style as decided in #146; three small unread marks (two beside the frame's right corner, one at the far left) drawn as strokes. Every element lies on the ink to within about 1 unit. Left out: the node at the top left, blotted out in ink (a crossing-out, not part of the figure; the two arrows that end on it are drawn).
